subject: A Plan to Help ABC Dental Studio Win More Local Patients on Google
title: Google Business Profile Growth Proposal
subtitle: Turn nearby Google searches into booked dental appointments
preparedFor: ABC Dental Studio - Dr. Avery Brown
serviceTitle: Google Business Profile Optimization - Monthly Growth Package
executiveSummary: When someone nearby searches for a dentist, ABC Dental Studio should be the first practice they see, trust, and call. FlowSmartly will fully optimize your Google Business Profile, publish weekly local posts, manage reviews, and strengthen citations so you climb into Google's local 3-pack. Every action is tied to one outcome: more patient calls, direction requests, and booked appointments. You get a transparent reporting portal so growth is measurable, not guesswork.
aboutBrand: FlowSmartly is an AI-powered growth platform built for local businesses. We combine brand-aware content, automated local listings, campaign tools, and reporting in one place. Our mission is simple: help practices like ABC Dental Studio attract more of the right patients without burning hours on marketing.
clientNeed: Most dental searches happen on Google with strong local intent - 'dentist near me', 'teeth whitening', 'emergency dentist'. If ABC Dental Studio isn't in the top 3 map results, the practice is losing those patients to competitors. A polished, active, well-reviewed Google Business Profile is the highest-ROI marketing asset a local dentist can own, and it needs consistent work to stay on top.
commitments: Full audit and optimization of your Google Business Profile within the first 7 days
Weekly Google posts featuring services, offers, and patient education
Ongoing review monitoring with branded response drafts for your approval
Monthly citation building and NAP consistency cleanup across local directories
Geotagged photo uploads to strengthen local relevance signals
Q&A seeding and management to answer common patient questions
Service and category fine-tuning to capture high-intent dental searches
Monthly performance report with calls, directions, views, and booking actions
Dedicated account manager and response within 1 business day
Transparent dashboard access so you can see progress anytime
benefits: Higher visibility in Google's local 3-pack for dental searches near your clinic
More phone calls and direction requests from ready-to-book patients
Stronger trust through a steady flow of fresh reviews and responses
Professional, consistent brand presence across Google and key directories
Time saved - your team focuses on patients, we handle the marketing
Better conversion from search to appointment with optimized profile content
Defense against competing dental practices in your service area
Clear ROI tracking tied to real patient actions, not vanity metrics
Improved relevance for high-value services like implants, whitening, and Invisalign
A long-term marketing asset that compounds in value month over month

terms: Service begins within 3 business days of profile access and onboarding details being received.
Client provides Google Business Profile manager access, service details, photos, and timely approvals.
Month-to-month agreement with no long-term contract. Cancel anytime after the first 30 days with written notice.
Refunds are not issued for completed work, but unused time can be paused with prior notice.
Performance ranges are based on typical results and are not guaranteed; rankings depend on Google's algorithm and local competition.
Reporting is delivered monthly via PDF and a live dashboard.
Delays in client approvals, access, or content delivery may shift posting and reporting timelines accordingly.
All content and assets created remain the property of ABC Dental Studio.
